items.title: Generac (GNRC) Q3 Earnings Strengthen As Data Center Push Draws Scrutiny
items.summary: Generac Holdings just posted its Q3 2026 scorecard and the headline is clear. Record quarterly revenue of US$1.29b and a sharp lift in adjusted EBITDA margins to 19.8% met a market that barely flinched, with the stock up about 1% to US$203.32 by the close. For an industrial power equipment maker leaning hard into data centers, that muted move says more about investor caution than the numbers themselves. items.title: Caterpillar Drops 7% as Moderate Sales Outlook Overshadows Beat; Deere Sits Out the Selloff, PACCAR Dips
items.summary: Caterpillar crushed earnings estimates and posted record orders stretching into 2030, yet the stock cratered while its machinery rivals barely flinched. The gap between what Wall Street expected and what management delivered reveals a fault line worth understanding before the next quarterly test arrives.
